verdict.rationale: Pipedream offers pre-built triggers and actions (pipedream-docs-12, pipedream-docs-28) and a step-based workflow builder with test-event triggering (pipedream-docs-13), and is described as 'low-code' where pre-built components can be used without code (pipedream-gh-3). However, its core value proposition and most docs emphasize writing Node.js/Python/Go/Bash code at any step (pipedream-docs-10, pipedream-gh-1, pipedream-gh-4), suggesting it's a hybrid code/no-code tool rather than a pure no-code visual builder for ops users. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a drag-and-drop visual canvas for wiring multi-step logic (branches/loops) entirely without code, and hands-on ops-user testimony confirming no-code usage for complex workflows.
